claims.text: The genericity gate blocks any added .md line naming BP-1 to BP-5 outside CHANGELOG.md, because BP-n matches the ticket-id pattern, BP is no notation prefix and hooks/genericity-allow.txt names no BP-n; the change must add BP-1 to BP-5 to the allow list with a reason, or join BP to notation-prefixes, which also stops redact.py redacting BP-n

A record written as JSON or YAML is scanned by no genericity check 1-3 and by no native-contract rule; a record or charter part written as .md is scanned by native-contract rule A, which blocks a line naming Codex or Claude Code, and by the genericity ticket-ID rule

The wiring gate needs each record's file stem (4 characters or more) named in another file, or it reports an orphan and blocks; an IOU passes only until the final run; a stem such as debate or solo is wired by unrelated grill and spec-folder lines, so naming each record file in the resolver is what makes the wiring real

The skill-registry gate reads only skill directories, agents, hook env vars and adapters/<family>/<kind>/ directories, so a record passes it unless it is placed under adapters/, where it is reported as a kind with no adapter.json
The native-contract gate's manifest, agent-stub, activation-path and line-ending rules read no data file; a record outside .agents/ and .codex/ passes them
The release gate compares the tag with five version sites only and reads no data file

FRESHNESS.md's same-commit rule names no data file; its row for FRESHNESS.md itself fires on a new artifact class, so the change adds a registry row for the records unless they sit under hooks/ or in a skill directory, whose rows already cover them, and it adds a CHANGELOG.md line under Unreleased
